title: The Law of Skin Diseases and the Declaration of Purity
description: The Lord gives Moses and Aaron detailed instructions on how the priest is to examine people with swellings, rashes, bright spots, sores, burns, scabs, and baldness, and decide whether they are clean or unclean. Anyone declared leprous must wear torn clothes, let their hair be unkempt, cover the upper lip, cry out, "Unclean! Unclean!" and live alone outside the camp.
